title: Form Retrieval at R2 and R3
label: ch:pa-form-r2-r3-retrieval
canDo: I can retrieve the known three-field and work-field writing tasks at R2 and R3 without adding a new field, value, or script shape.

payoff.summary: The learner selects a known work value, hides the bank, writes one row after a short delay, and checks spelling, spacing, and field agreement.
